known_failure_modes.behavior: derived in adults; the maturation of body composition in children is not captured, so FFM is mis-stated below the derivation age. Al-Sallami (2015) extends the same form into childhood.

extraction.tier_rationale: Well-behaved monotone FFM (no James-style inversion); derived in a broad adult cohort including the obese. BMI uses height in cm via bmi = 10000*weight/height_cm^2. Awaits human confirmation of the sex-specific denominators.
extraction.source_locator: Janmahasatian S et al., Clin Pharmacokinet 2005; the form Kim 2017 scales on
